manifest_name: NeuroVision AI - Phase 7 Stage C Controlled Optimization Execution Manifest
author: Senior Medical AI Research Scientist & ML Systems Engineer

calibration_cohort.usage: Exclusively for threshold search and objective optimization

locked_test_cohort.usage: Single-pass evaluation after threshold is frozen

objective_function.formula: J(tau) = w_wt_dice * WT_Dice(tau) + w_wt_prec * WT_Prec(tau) + w_tc_dice * TC_Dice(tau) + w_et_dice * ET_Dice(tau) - lambda * MARE_WT(tau)

mare_definition.per_patient_safety_check: if V_gt <= 0: raise ValueError('Ground-truth WT volume must be positive')

tie_breaking_rules.tier_1: Higher calibration mean Whole Tumor Recall (WT_Recall)
tie_breaking_rules.tier_2: Lower calibration Mean Absolute Relative Error (MARE_WT)

individual_patient_level.anti_masking_rule: Cohort averages must never conceal individual patient failures; any flagged patient requires explicit case-level radiologic post-mortem

execution_sequence_and_isolation: Step 1: Checkpoint SHA-256 pre-flight verification against this manifest.
Step 2: Run inference strictly on the 5 calibration patients using checkpoints/adaptive/best.pth.
Step 3: Sweep the 9 candidate thresholds on calibration softmax probabilities.
Step 4: Compute J(tau) and apply acceptance gating and tie-breaking to select optimal tau*.
Step 5: Cryptographically seal selected tau* into selected_threshold.json.
Step 6: Only after tau* is frozen, run single-pass evaluation on the 5 locked-test patients across Arms 1, 2, and 3.
Step 7: Compute per-patient metrics, MARE, cohort statistics, and individual-patient gating flags.
Step 8: Output locked_test_results.csv, statistical_tests.json, and individual_patient_audit.json.

governance_restrictions.automatic_retraining: PROHIBITED. If acceptance criteria fail, halt execution and produce a separate Retraining Proposal requiring explicit human approval.
governance_restrictions.production_modification: PROHIBITED. Zero files in dashboard/backend, dashboard/frontend, or src/ may be modified during Stage C.
governance_restrictions.locked_test_modifications: PROHIBITED. The locked-test split cannot be altered before or after observing outcomes.
governance_restrictions.candidate_threshold_modifications: PROHIBITED. Only the 9 pre-registered thresholds may be evaluated.
